test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

She is senior than him in the department.
solution:
The correct answer is '**is senior to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct usage when comparing hierarchy or rank is "**senior to**" and not "senior than".
 
• The word "**senior**" is an adjective that is followed by "to" in such contexts.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 3</stron
